comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and Citi disclose year-over-year changes in their average loan and deposit volumes, though they experienced opposite trends in 2024. JPM reported that firmwide average loans grew 6% to $1.3 trillion and average deposits rose 1% to $2.4 trillion, driven by client spending and account activity. In contrast, Citi reported that average loans decreased 1% as the business optimized capital usage, while average deposits increased 2%, influenced by $17 billion in transfers from USPB.
